sourceFindings: Actual June collection is S33_CHARACTER_customer_june.001 with 52 objects. The head, hair, torso, limbs and face use separate weighted native meshes and a single named armature.
The source snapshot has a large pink cap and a row of small blunt fringe pieces; face, clothing and hands read as hard planar blocks with flat dark undersides.
June identity is bright pink bob/fringe, warm yellow collared shirt, dark blue shorts, peach skin and friendly dark eyes. These recognizable colors and role must carry through the refinement.
targetFindings: Target offers fuller rounded bob volumes, swept lobes on crown and fringe, softened jaw corners, warm skin gradients, shiny oval eyes with bright small catchlights, rosy cheeks and a small curved smile.
Target shirt has a purposeful soft polo collar, short inset placket, rolled sleeve edge and waistband seam; shorts have cuff separation and small pocket curves. Shoes are brown and softly rounded.
Target has much more three dimensional, rounded light response than source while retaining broad simplified readable masses. Tiny fabric marks are secondary to silhouette, collar and face.
styleFindings: Plant reference combines saturated warm yellow edging, vibrant green folded volumes, softened broad planar highlights and localized warm depth. It is not monochrome clay or a gray washed out material.
I would keep warm saturated midtones and selective smooth curvature, with broad controlled highlights and local occlusion rather than blanket black undersides.
nativeApproachIntent: Inspect all actual actions and dynamic envelope before replacing visible head/hair/clothing geometry. Preserve rig/rest/actions/root and functional contacts.
Use native rounded head/crown and fringe meshes, useful clothing construction and intentional smooth normals. Rebind all new forms to the original intended deformation groups.
Choose broad symmetric soft lighting and tailored materials; do not use target pixels on an actor billboard.
limitationsAtObservationStage: Original source-asset metadata reports historical scale and camera. Actual current capture must be remeasured from source and frozen brief before export.
Only original stand image and native structure inspected at this stage; animated contacts and deformed surfaces require complete validation later.
